title: Server fetches of user-provided image and crawl URLs resolve DNS and block private addresses
detail: fetchRemoteImage has no guard on a public route; lib/ai/web/index.ts:118 and lib/importer/harvest/media.ts:67 check hostnames only and follow redirects. Reuse the pinned fetch from lib/qr/remote-logo.ts (#3919). Also extend the private range list (192.0.0.0/24, 198.18.0.0/15, NAT64, 6to4).

verify.note: Exits 0 only when the repair has landed; fails on main today.
